name: SimilarTube
tagline: SimilarTube is an AI-powered similar YouTube channel finder. Paste a channel URL or @handle to discover related channels.
description:
SimilarTube helps brands, agencies, and marketers find similar YouTube channels from one example channel — no long keyword list. AI-powered look-alike search surfaces related channels; you can review subscriber, view, and engagement signals, explore adjacent niches, and use Saved Lists and the Chrome extension for screening and outreach research.

Features:
Find similar YouTube channels from a channel URL or @handle
AI-powered look-alike / similarity search by content, niche, and audience
Niche discovery and adjacent-topic exploration
Channel metrics for screening (subscribers, views, engagement; availability varies)
Saved Lists, folders, and labels for organizing research
Chrome extension for real-time research while browsing YouTube, including filters such as country, average views, likes, engagement rate, and subscriber count
Review publicly listed business emails and linked social or website pages where available (email matching is a separate, non-free-trial feature)

Free plan: Extension/account trial is 10 limited free searches every 24 hours, without email matching. The website finder (https://www.similartube.co/find/similar-youtube-channels) is free and gives 10 results per search. Email matching is not part of the free trial.
